headline: City Union Bank Limited: Outcome of Board Meeting — Fund Raising through QIP
sum: City Union Bank's board approved a qualified institutional placement (QIP) to raise capital through the issuance of equity shares to institutional investors, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.
detail: The board of directors of City Union Bank Limited, a mid-sized private sector scheduled commercial bank headquartered in Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu, approved a fund-raising initiative via QIP on 23 June 2026. The mechanism allows issuance of equity shares to qualified institutional buyers at a price determined by market discovery, subject to shareholder approval in general meeting and compliance with SEBI Regulations 2018 (QIP norms). No quantum or specific timeline was disclosed in the board outcome document.
